target.displayed_identity: Twitter Cyclone electronic / 骓特龙卷风三代 ET

method: Fifty genuinely distinct registered source areas were checked once at model level, then each atomic field received a field-specific acceptance or rejection application. Public XHS was limited to search-engine indexes under the shared runtime coordination; no new XHS job, browser-profile bypass, login, CAPTCHA or security-verification action was attempted.
identity_note: The repository electronic configuration names WheelTop EDS TX 2x12. Current manufacturer and mainland indexes consistently call that configuration CYCLONE-3rd (ET), Chinese 龙卷风三代 ET. The separate historic 8.7 kg observation is preserved as configuration/time-bounded rather than silently replaced by the current 9.2 kg claim.
